title: Darth Chameleon
body:
# 🦎 Darth Chameleon ### Hide & seek where you don't *find* a disguise - you **paint** one. *Shrink down, paint your own skin pixel by pixel, strike a pose, and freeze into the scenery while seekers hunt you down with paint guns.*
--- #### [Download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/10JkMXmzGgPGP155a02jebLSsKI0kg9BP/view?usp=sharing) Prepared Map, already ready for the game. ## 🏟️ Setting up an arena Everything is driven by the operator-only `/chameleon` command (you need OP / gamemaster permission). Each point is saved **from where you're standing, including which way you face**, so aim before you set it. **Three points make an arena:** | Step | Stand at… | Run | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | The pre-game **lobby** (where everyone waits between rounds) | `/chameleon setlobby` | | 2 | The **hiding field** spawn (where hiders start each round) | `/chameleon setfield` | | 3 | The **seeker holding area** (where seekers wait during Prep) | `/chameleon setseekerlobby` | That's it - you're ready to play: ``` /chameleon start ```
⚙️ Tuning the game (optional config)
All values persist per world. Set them with `/chameleon config

Original game: "Meccha Chameleon" by lemorion_1224, not affiliated.
